newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian O/N rates end firmer at 20.875/21.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian O/N rates end firmer at 20.875/21.00 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates finished a little above Friday's closing levels on Monday in what dealers called modest activity on the first day of banks' two-week reserve period.
"The market was not particularly active," said Sandor Szatmari of Unicbank.
Overnight rates ended at 20.875/21.00 percent, compared to 20.50/21.00 percent at opening and 20.25 percent at Friday's close.
Dealers said they did not expect interest rates to come down substantially in the coming days as banks were filling their reserves.
